Package com.eqixiac.equinix.core.http.request

package com.eqixiac.equinix.core.http.request
HTTP request model for the Equinix Java SDK. EquinixRequest represents a typed API request — headers, query parameters, path variables, and a single RequestBody (JSON payload, form fields, or raw bytes). PaginatedRequest adds offset/limit paging state for paginated GET endpoints, and PaginatedPostRequest carries POST-search bodies whose paging state lives in the body itself. At dispatch, RequestFactory converts the populated request into the transport (Apache HttpClient) request that goes on the wire, building the entity from the RequestBody once per attempt; no transport type appears in the request model's API.

    RequestFactory
    Converts a fully-populated EquinixRequest into the Apache HttpRequestBase that is actually sent on the wire: resolves the URI (endpoint + resource path + encoded query parameters), picks the method-specific Apache request class (including the body-carrying HttpDeleteWithBody when a DELETE has a body), builds the wire entity from the request's RequestBody (serializing JSON payloads, encoding form fields, or attaching raw bytes), and copies the request headers.
